scope: ONS chart-pattern adaptation to native Home Assistant; this source record is not live deployment evidence

upstream.runtimeDependency: Highcharts 12.6.2 in upstream package.json; not bundled by this project

codeSources.use: Reference palettes, chart label roles and marker geometry
Transparent plot, top-left legend, horizontal labels, accessibility and animation defaults
Square columns, border removal, spacing and responsive width references
Three-pixel round-ended line and marker behaviour
Highcharts integration and native ONS series handling
Figure structure, title, description and optional supporting content

guidanceSources.use: Horizontal bar component and macro interface
Time-based stacked columns and macro interface
Conditional captions, descriptions, footnotes and downloads
Gridline widths, legend placement and symbol dimensions
Minimum chart text size and horizontal typography
Reference colours, category limits and cross-chart consistency
Zero baseline, time-axis treatment and responsive tick density
Useful initial view and alternatives to motion
Composition of totals, vertical time series and limits of stack comparisons
Missing observations, restrained markers and appropriate line semantics

legend.position: above plot, left aligned, horizontal wrapping

componentSeriesLimits.additionalSeries: upstream ignores additional series; never adopt this behaviour for native HA data

civicaContract.implementation: Original presentation adapter for native Home Assistant ECharts; no Highcharts dependency
civicaContract.activation: Optional companion while a civica theme is selected; restore native presentation on deactivation
civicaContract.dataOwner: Home Assistant; do not recalculate, reaggregate, reorder, truncate, interpolate or otherwise rewrite native data
civicaContract.colours: Generated opaque colours from stable identity keys with semantic energy families; Vivid/Muted follows theme and is independent of Light/Dark and brand palette
civicaContract.font: Use the civica Arial stack and respect the native text scale; no Open Sans download
civicaContract.legend: Preserve native visibility controls and labels; add matching colour/pattern keys and restore native inline styling on deactivation
civicaContract.dataAlternative: View data disclosure with semantic table; all supported supplied values including legend-hidden series, independent of zoom. 100 rows per page with explicit count, no silent total-row cap. Original comparison timestamps retained; unsupported shapes and absent units explained.
civicaContract.dates: Keep HA number-format, 12/24-hour and local/server time-zone preferences. Use Time for two-value samples and Period start when originalStart is supplied. Offset distinguishes repeated local clock times. Native range selection and comparison behaviour remain unchanged.
civicaContract.distribution: Native Energy distribution diagram is a controlled deviation and is not adapted or given a new data table; no ONS Sankey component claimed.
civicaContract.scopeLimits: Seven named native Energy Cartesian bar/line charts only; History, pie, distribution and third-party renderers remain native.
civicaContract.verification: Native-shaped Canvas/SVG fixtures must start with actual HA alpha fills, gradients, thin area borders and hover states. Verify final geometry and colours, then compare populated live routes.
civicaContract.power: Individual unfilled, unsmoothed lines; remove cumulative display stacking without changing source arrays or values
civicaContract.lineWidthSource: ENERGY_CHART_SPEC.lineWidth in ui/src/energy-charts.ts; shared by normal, hover, selected and blurred lines and legend keys in the companion and working examples
civicaContract.lineWidthDeviation: 1.5px is a local adaptation for dense household power data; the reviewed ONS line and legend stroke remain 3px
civicaContract.comparison: Use same identity colour with hatch patterns for columns; use stable dash patterns for lines
